fullContentHtml:
CISF Constable Fire Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) has released the Exam Date for the post of Constable Fire. This recruitment has been issued for 1130 posts. Applications for CISF Constable Fire Recruitment 2024 were filled from 31 August 2024 to 30 September 2024. The Exam is going to conducted on 01 December 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can Check their Exam Date from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 21 August 2024
  • Application Start Date : 31 August 2024
  • Last Date : 30 September 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 September 2024
  • DV/PET/PST Exam Date : 24 December 2024 to 20 January 2024
  • Admit Card : 16 December 2024
  • Exam Date : 01 December 2026
  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the Exam Date link.
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Registration no.
  • Login ID
  • Birth Date/Password
  • Captcha Code
  • Then the candidates have to submit the details by clicking on the Login button.
  • Alternatively, the candidates can Check the Exam Date from the official website of CISF also.

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, ESM : Rs. 0/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Check Exam Date Notice
  • Download PET/PST/DV Admit Card
  • Download PET/PST/DV Selected Candidate List
  • Download PET/PST/DV Exam Date Notice
  • Apply Online (Registration)
  • Download Notification

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is CISF Constable Fire Exam Date 2026?

CISF Constable Fire Exam Date 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
